title: Palmer Luckey Launches Military Dog Startup Warhound
excerpt: Warhound exits stealth with $200 million in funding to develop genetically modified military working dogs with advanced body armor.
body_html:
A new startup named Warhound has launched out of stealth, securing $200 million in funding. Founded by Palmer Luckey, the company aims to develop genetically modified military working dogs.

According to the announcement, the startup's mission is to create elite working animals equipped with advanced body armor for defense applications.
